brief: a lyric video for my Hindi song

context.platform: YouTube and Reels, 16:9 and 9:16, length of the song

concept: The words fall like the monsoon the song is about: each line a drop that lands on the beat.
plan_outline: 1. Kinetic type (pages, HyperFrames) · each lyric line in a Devanagari face, falling and settling on the beat
2. Background · slow abstract footage of rain on glass (generated, no words in it), darkened under the type
3. Chorus · the key word of each line enlarged, in the accent colour, with a ripple on the downbeat
4. End card · the song's title and the artist's handle
why: A lyric video is motion graphics, not generated text: type is set as pages, never drawn by a video model.
Devanagari needs a face that has its glyphs (Noto Sans Devanagari, Mukta); the user's exact lyrics only.
The motion language (fall, settle, ripple) comes from the song's own image, kept consistent.
